Lina: Quick sync, team — partner wants a single perf/W chart and one-sentence blurb for the cloud marketplace tile by EOD. Can we lock numbers? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Marco: Running final repeat on Ampere instances now. Preliminary looks like 6-8% t/J uplift at 512 seq. I'll push CSV in 20m.

BenchBot: bench-run started: job=amp-repeat-1755000000-marco status=RUNNING

Zoe: For kernel tunables we used `--kv-prefetch=2 --kv-cache-max=3g` and `batch_timeout=5ms` for the uplift. Need to confirm exact flags for the marketplace notes.

Marco: CSV uploaded: /shared/partner-bench/1755000000/ampere_repeat.csv. Key summary: 512 seq + kv-prefetch=2 => +7.2% tokens/J on avg, p95 comparable to baseline.

Legal: Logo usage cleared. Short blurb must not mention partner internal model names. Also avoid absolute claims like "always".

Lina: Draft blurb: "Improves energy efficiency up to 7% for production sequence lengths; maintains p95 latency." Shorten if needed.

Zoe: Works for me. I'll add the exact kernel flags in the metadata field (immutable container tag + SHA).

BenchBot: bench-run completed: job=amp-repeat-1755000000-marco status=SUCCESS duration=2h14m artifacts=/s3/bench/amp-repeat-1755000000

Lina: Good. Action items: Marco confirm p95 numbers in p95.csv, Zoe attach container tag + SHA to marketplace draft, Legal sign-off on blurb. Partner call at 3pm PT to approve. Any blockers? :thumbsup:
